headline: Dover Completes Acquisition of Leistung Engineering
summary: Dover Corporation announced the completion of its previously reported acquisition of Leistung Engineering Pvt. Ltd. The acquired entity will operate within the OPW Fluid Transfer Solutions division under Dover's Clean Energy & Fueling segment.
why: Dover Corporation is a diversified global manufacturer providing equipment and components, specialty systems, and support services. Strategic acquisitions in its clean energy segment expand its operational footprint and product offerings.

impacts.name: Dover Corporation
impacts.why: Dover completed the acquisition of Leistung Engineering, integrating it into its Clean Energy & Fueling segment.
